vectors.name: signing_request
vectors.description: Signing request with one DESCRIPTOR (alias "main", FORM 0x01 descriptor wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*), POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a), a 19-byte PSBT holding an empty version 2 transaction, and WANT_KIND present and set to 0x02 (signatures only).

vectors.name: signing_response_psbt
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x01, carrying back the same 19-byte PSBT.

vectors.name: signing_response_signatures
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with one signature of every SIG_KIND: input 0 SIG_KIND 0x01 (segwit) with a 33-byte compressed key and a 71-byte signature, input 1 SIG_KIND 0x02 (tapkey) with a 64-byte signature, input 2 SIG_KIND 0x03 (taptree) with a 32-byte x-only key, a 32-byte leaf hash and a 65-byte signature.

vectors.name: signing_response_musig_pub_nonces
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with two SIG_KIND 0x04 (musig pubnonce) entries, one per slot: input 0 with a 33-byte compressed PARTICIPANT, a 33-byte AGGREGATE of 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x11, LEAF_HASH absent (key path, presence byte 0x00) and a 66-byte PUB_NONCE of 0x22; input 1 with the same PARTICIPANT, a 33-byte AGGREGATE of 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x33, LEAF_HASH present (presence byte 0x01) as 32 bytes of 0x44 (script path) and a 66-byte PUB_NONCE of 0x55. PUB_NONCE has no LENGTH prefix.

vectors.name: signing_response_musig_partial_sigs
vectors.description: Signing ok response of KIND 0x02 with two SIG_KIND 0x05 (musig partial sig) entries over the same two slots: input 0 with the 33-byte compressed PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x11, LEAF_HASH absent (presence byte 0x00) and a 32-byte PARTIAL_SIG of 0x66; input 1 with the same PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x33, LEAF_HASH present (presence byte 0x01) as 32 bytes of 0x44 and a 32-byte PARTIAL_SIG of 0x77. PARTIAL_SIG has no LENGTH prefix.
